(10 July) |matches= 590 |total goals= 1219 |longest wins= |longest unbeaten= |longest losses= |prevseason= [[2020 Primera Nacional|2020]] |nextseason= [[2022 Primera Nacional|2022]] }} The '''2021 Argentine Primera Nacional''', also known as the '''Campeonato de Primera Nacional 2021''',{{cite web|url=https://www.afa.com.ar/es/posts/se-estan-llevando-a-cabo-los-sorteos-de-la-primera-nacional-primera-b-y-primera-c |title=Se llevaron a cabo los sorteos de la Primera Nacional, Primera B y Primera C |publisher=AFA |language=es |date=25 February 2021 |access-date=27 February 2021}} was the 37th season of the [[Primera Nacional]], the second tier of [[Football in Argentina|Argentine]] football. The season began on 12 March 2021 and ended on 21 December 2021. Thirty-five teams competed in the league, thirty returning from the [[2020 Primera Nacional|2020 season]], two teams promoted from [[Torneo Federal A]] and three from [[Primera B Metropolitana]]. [[Club Atlético Tigre|Tigre]] were the champions, winning their first Primera Nacional title by beating [[Barracas Central]] by a 1–0 score in the final played on 22 November 2021 and earned promotion to the [[Argentine Primera División]].{{cite web |title=Tigre vence a Barracas Central, es campeón de la Primera Nacional y jugará en la Liga Profesional de Fútbol |url=https://argentina.as.com/argentina/2021/11/23/futbol/1637634408_479991.html |publisher=AS Argentina |access-date=25 November 2021 |language=es |date=22 November 2021}} ==Format== The 35 teams were split into two zones, one of 17 teams and another one of 18 teams, where they played against the other teams in their group twice: once at home and once away, with one team in Zone A having a bye in each round for a total of 34 rounds. Both zone winners played a final match on neutral ground to decide the first promoted team to the [[Argentine Primera División|Liga Profesional]] for the [[2022 Argentine Primera División|2022 season]], while the teams placed from second to fourth place in each zone played a knockout tournament (''Torneo Reducido'') for the second promotion berth along with the loser of the final between the zone winners, which joined the Reducido in the semi-finals. No teams were relegated to either Primera B Metropolitana or Torneo Federal A this season. The draw to decide the groups and fixture was held on 25 February 2021.{{cite web|url=https://www.infobae.com/deportes/2021/02/25/se-sorteo-la-primera-nacional-los-35-equipos-que-la-jugaran-como-se-definiran-los-ascensos-y-cual-sera-la-primera-fecha/|title=Se sorteó la Primera Nacional: los 35 equipos que la jugarán, cómo se definirán los ascensos y cuál será la primera fecha|publisher=Infobae|date=25 February 2021|access-date=27 February 2021}} ==Club information== === Stadia and locations === {{location map+ |Argentina |float=right |width=300 |caption=Locations of the 2021 Primera Nacional teams outside [[Greater Buenos Aires]]. |places= {{location map~ |Argentina |lat=-34.603611 |long=-58.381667 |label=
